The O4 quiz is at `quizzes/0002.json`, with its key at `keys/0002.json`. It opens with five definition questions (q1–q5) and then applies them in five makerspace-assistant cases (q6–q10). Question q8 is a numeric cost-per-request item. I did not run the JSON files through any parser or validator, only checked them by hand.

- **Review:** The `quiz-reviewer` subagent checked it, and two review-and-revise passes ran. The record is in `review-records/0002-quiz.md`.
- **Ahead of the lessons:** No lesson covers O4. I built the quiz from Anthropic's "Building effective agents", based on search results only; I did not open the page itself.
- **Misconception ids:** The key's misconception ids (M10 and up) are new, because I could not read the existing key for quiz 0001. If any of them collide with ids already in use, they will need reconciling.
- **Left unchanged:** The reviewer suggested replacing q4 (prompt chaining) and q5 (routing). I kept them because the objective's contrast depends on those patterns and the replacements would have repeated q7 and q9.

The quiz is ready when you are.
